fields.description: Equestra is a residential collection at Grand Polo Club & Resort, bringing three and four bedroom townhouse rows together with larger five-bedroom residences. Linear parks connect the neighbourhood to the community’s equestrian setting. The townhouse and five-bedroom plans have different floor arrangements, area measurements and launch pricing.

overview: Equestra sits within a masterplan organised around an equestrian Green Core and a branching network of landscaped spaces. Its brochure combines neutral interiors and park-facing homes with shared places for swimming, exercise and informal recreation. The clubhouse, polo fields and stables belong to the wider community setting. The launch material also identifies cycling routes, a forest walk and gardens, alongside play areas for children. Confirm the delivery timetable and any separate access arrangements for the facilities that matter to your household.
research.locationNote: Grand Polo Club & Resort is in south-west Dubai, with Al Maktoum International Airport, The Oasis and Expo City identified in the launch material as nearby reference destinations. Published journey times are indicative; verify the actual entrance and daily route rather than treating them as a commute guarantee.
research.priceNote: The official project page advertises AED 3.5m. Equestra’s launch fact sheet instead provides average prices: AED 3.7m for three-bedroom, AED 4.9m for four-bedroom and AED 11.2m for five-bedroom homes. Property Finder labels AED 3.7m as a launch price. These figures have different bases; confirm the selected unit’s current quotation.
research.paymentNote: The launch structure is 10% on booking, four further 10% instalments, two 15% construction instalments and 20% at estimated completion. The larger intermediate stages are tied to 60% and 80% construction. Past calendar instalments require an updated schedule for a new purchase.
research.handoverNote: August 2029 is the estimated completion month on the Equestra payment sheet and Property Finder. The contractual completion date and current construction programme require confirmation.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: 361 homes: 204 three-bedroom townhouses, 130 four-bedroom townhouses and 27 five-bedroom residences. Average plots are 1,576, 2,990 and 5,394 sq ft respectively; individual plots vary.

facts.label: What the plan area includes
facts.value: Printed totals combine suite, garage and balcony/terrace areas. They are neither internal-only areas nor land measurements. Style E’s 5,039.77 sq ft, for example, includes a 3,910.53 sq ft suite, 549.39 sq ft garage and 579.85 sq ft balconies/terraces.

facts.label: Different home arrangements
facts.value: Townhouse key plans show four, six and eight-home rows. Four-bedroom Style A includes a downstairs guest bedroom and maid’s room. Five-bedroom residences extend over three levels; Style E places a bedroom and terrace on its second floor.

facts.label: Reading the portal listing
facts.value: Property Finder’s unit table lists only three and four bedroom townhouses. The developer’s own plans also show five-bedroom Styles E and F, retained in this project’s accommodation mix.
